description: EOS mapped against the 13-layer production stack from Phase 14.5A -- current state, target state, gaps, blockers, readiness, risk, and cross-layer dependencies for all 13 layers.
provenance_detail: Synthesized from: phase14_5a_eos_13_layer_production_stack.json (Phase 14.5A original 13-layer stack), phase14_6b_eos_current_implementation_truth.json (code-resolved current state across GitHub main, Beast branch, UMH projection), phase14_6b_eos_api_contract_map.json (72 GitHub main routes, 14 Beast route modules, UMH platform routes), phase14_6b_eos_data_ontology.json (3 schema surfaces, 15+6+8 tables), phase14_6b_eos_auth_security_truth.json (Passport.js vs Clerk vs UMH middleware auth surfaces), phase14_6b_eos_agent_architecture_spec.json (10 department agents + EA + Portfolio Advisor hierarchy), phase14_6b_eos_workflow_sop_engine_spec.json (3 implemented + 8 target workflows), phase14_6b_eos_governance_permissions_model.json (RBAC+ABAC hybrid model), phase14_6b_eos_business_template_library.json (UBOS template library), phase14_6b_eos_org_chart_engine_spec.json (10 departments, 10 roles), phase14_6b_eos_source_inventory.json (all source surfaces).
layer_schema_note: This mapping uses the 13-layer production stack schema defined in Phase 14.5A, re-aligned to application-centric concerns: Frontend Foundations, APIs+Backend, Database+Storage, Auth+Permissions, AI+Agent Runtime, Workflow Engine, Memory+Knowledge, Analytics+Observability, Infrastructure+Deployment, Testing+QA, Documentation, Security+Compliance, Integration+Ecosystem. This differs from the original 14.5A 13 layers which used infra-centric naming (Hosting, Cloud, CI/CD, Rate Limiting, Caching, Load Balancing, Availability). The re-alignment better captures EOS as an AI-native application platform.
